mentions.name: KlongPy
mentions.description: KlongPy is an array programming language; this update adds autograd support to the language, with PyTorch integration and new example programs demonstrating it.
mentions.source_excerpt: I added autograd support to the KlongPy array language. It’s been fun to integrate PyTorch and come up with new examples.
